data.one_liner: Easily draw arrows with Path objects and composite them onto any curve.
data.what_it_does: Draws arrows using the direction of the tangent to the curve at the end of the curve. Allows paths to be composited so you can add arrows to any curve and draw everything all at once.
use_when: You need to draw arrows on custom Path objects or curves in Flutter.
You want to add single or double-sided arrow tips to your custom paths easily.
avoid_when: You are looking for pre-built chart graphs or map routing overlays.
You want a fully declarative UI widget kit for arrow components.
strengths: Simplifies drawing arrows on generic Path objects.
Supports adjustment parameters for high-curvature endpoints.
Supports both single and double-sided arrows.
weaknesses: No pre-built charting or diagramming UI components.
